duration.text: The Economics at Renmin University of China is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Original of Application Form for International Students of Renmin University of China to Study in ChinaAfter completing the online application, it can be downloaded and the applicant needs to print and sign to confirm.2. Original or notarized high school diploma certificateIf the applicant has graduated, they must provide a copy of their high school graduation certificate and an original notarized diploma issued by a notary public; in compliance withThe applicant is a recent graduate who must first provide the original expected graduation certificate issued by their school and submit it before enrollmentAcademic proof documents.3. Original or notarized transcripts of all high school courses4. A letter of recommendationIssued and signed by the teachers, homeroom teachers, school leaders, or other official institution leaders of the middle school where they are located for confirmation; recommendThe letter must include the recommender's name, position or title, institution, and email address.5. Original or notarized proof of language proficiencyThe original HSK score report (valid for 2 years) must be sent directly to our school by Hankou International, and individual students are not acceptedSubmit, applicants can apply for this service on the Chinese Language Examination Service website (www.chinesetest. cn).6. Original or notarized copies of international university entrance examination scoresIf applying for exemption from written examination, the applicant must provide internationally recognized university entrance examination scores that meet the requirements of our school for exemption from written examination.7. Original copy of guarantee letterYou can access it on your own from the website of our international student office（ http://iso.ruc.edu.cn ）Download and fill in, and have the applicant's parents orSignature of legal guardian.8. Original proof of guarantor's economic abilityIncluding but not limited to the guarantor's proof of employment income and bank deposit certificate (not less than RMB 30000 or equivalent)Foreign currency, etc.9. Personal StatementWritten in Chinese, it must include but not limited to personal information, family member information, past life and study experiences, and participationThe social activities and plans for university life should be no less than 1000 words.10. Original certificate of no criminal record:(1) Applicants in China must provide a valid certificate of no criminal record in China.(2) Applicants who are not in China must provide a certificate of no criminal record issued by the public security management department of their country of residence.11. Copy of passport front pageThe applicant should submit the application with a personal ordinary passport, which must be valid no earlier than March 31, 2026; Currently inApplicants from China must also provide a copy of their valid residence permit held in China.

requirements.text: (1) Academic and Age Requirements Applicants for a bachelor's degree should have completed high school education with excellent academic performance and generally be under 25 years old. Applicants for a master's degree should have a bachelor's degree or equivalent, with excellent academic performance and generally be under 35 years old. Applicants for a doctoral degree should have a master's degree or equivalent, with excellent academic performance and generally be under 40 years old. (2) Complete application in RUC system Students applying for the "Silk Road" scholarship must have submitted their application through the Renmin University of China International Student Application System and have been admitted by RUC as self-support students.
